item.title: Version 1.50.8 (140)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.50.8

Build 140

  • Merges pasted folders with existing same-named folders
  • Never overwrites existing files; conflicts are skipped and reported
  • Opens in native macOS fullscreen on launch
  • Shows detailed file and byte progress while copying
